verdicts.rationale: The coverage check found no developer or API page (/api and api.cashflowportal.com return 404), and the Zapier integration claim (c7) does not show a public API.
verdicts.missing: Any public API documentation for reading and changing core records such as investors, raises and distributions; the MCP server is judged under its own story.

verdicts.rationale: The vendor's MCP page resolves (p1), says Claude or ChatGPT can answer questions from live investor, distribution and waterfall data (c3) with a sample reply that sets up a waterfall (c5), and pricing lists an 'AI Native / MCP' item in the Syndication Suite (c2), but the page is marketing with no setup steps or tool list and its call to action is a demo request (c4, c6).
verdicts.missing: Setup steps, a list of MCP tools, the server endpoint and authentication method, and whether the server is generally available rather than offered through a demo; the support site's content was unread.

verdicts.rationale: The pack shows no official SDK or command-line tool on any package registry or public repository.
verdicts.missing: Any vendor-maintained SDK or CLI, on a package registry or in a public repository.

verdicts.rationale: The only event path shown is a Zapier integration advertising two-way sync with over 5,000 apps (c7), and no native webhook or event documentation was found.
verdicts.missing: Native webhooks or event subscriptions, and which Zapier triggers exist for which records; the integration claim is marketing copy with no trigger list.

verdicts.rationale: The MCP page says CFP MCP only surfaces data the user is already authorized to see with no new access controls to set up (c4), and the app offers role-based access for co-GPs (c11), but no API keys, tokens or credential scopes are documented.
verdicts.missing: How an agent authenticates (API key, token or OAuth client), whether an agent can get a credential of its own, and documented scopes or permissions that limit a credential; c11 covers co-GP user roles in the app, not credentials.

verdicts.rationale: No API was found, and the pack shows no OpenAPI, Swagger, GraphQL or other machine-readable specification.
verdicts.missing: Any OpenAPI, Swagger, GraphQL or similar specification, downloadable or shown in docs.

verdicts.rationale: The support site renders only in a browser and its content is unread, and the pack shows no llms.txt file or Markdown documentation pages.
verdicts.missing: An llms.txt file or Markdown versions of the documentation pages.

verdicts.rationale: The pack shows no sandbox, test mode or developer environment for working before touching live records.
verdicts.missing: Any self-serve or on-request sandbox, test mode or developer environment documented for developers; the free 'explore the platform' account (c8) is a product sign-up, not a documented test environment.

verdicts.rationale: The pack shows no export or download of records in any format.
verdicts.missing: Any self-serve bulk export or download of investor, raise or distribution records in CSV, JSON, Excel or another open format, and its documentation.

verdicts.rationale: The home page offers 'Start for free' with no credit card required and the investor-management page says an account can be created instantly (c8), and the Syndication Suite carries a listed price while only the Fund Admin Suite and Enterprise tiers show a demo button (c1).
verdicts.missing: Whether the free start is a trial of the paid Syndication Suite or a limited free tier, and whether a paid plan can be started without a call; the Fund Admin Suite and Enterprise tiers need a demo.

verdicts.rationale: The pricing page gives only a starting price, 'Starts at $699/month' for the Syndication Suite, and no price for the Fund Admin Suite or Enterprise tiers (c1).
verdicts.missing: What the $699/month plan includes and the full price schedule behind 'starts at', and any prices for the Fund Admin Suite and Enterprise tiers.

verdicts.rationale: No API was found and the Zapier integration (c7) is described only as generic two-way sync, so the pack shows no way for an agent to create investors or send subscription documents.
verdicts.missing: API or integration documentation for creating investor records and for sending or starting subscription documents.

verdicts.rationale: Distributions appear only as in-app features, the Distribution Engine waterfall builder (c9) and automated LP payments with no API route shown (c10), and the pack shows no API to create distributions or generate notices.
verdicts.missing: Any API route to create or read distributions and to generate or send investor notices; the MCP page's claim that Claude can answer questions about distributions (c3) is not an API and lists no tools.

verdicts.rationale: The pack shows no API endpoint or documented export that returns investors, commitments and contributions as structured data.
verdicts.missing: Any API endpoint or export, even a manual one in the app, returning investors, commitments and contributions as JSON or CSV; the MCP claim of answering questions about investors (c3) shows no structured output.

verdicts.rationale: The pack shows no capital-call feature or API, and the only funding-tracking claim (c10) concerns distribution payments sent to LPs, not investor contributions.
verdicts.missing: Any API or documentation for creating capital calls and reading each investor's funding status.
